name: source-physical-spans
objective: Ensure selectable source representations preserve exact physical source coordinates and text for valid Python containing non-newline Unicode separators in strings, with LF, CRLF or CR source. Preserve decorated async symbols, windows, source coverage, identity and existing search behavior. Investigate the responsible implementation and related contracts before proposing a one-file correction.
oracle:
import ast
from io import StringIO
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from devtools.core.paths import resolve_path
from devtools.resources.filesystem import TextFile, write
from devtools.context.repository.identity import Repository
from devtools.context.repository.resource import RepositoryResourceAddress
from devtools.context.repository.discovery import discover_repository_resource_addresses
from devtools.context.repository.observation import observe_repository_resources
from devtools.context.repository.corpus import define_repository_text_corpus, realize_repository_text_corpus
from devtools.context.retrieval import build_source_search_index, search_repository_source
for separator in ('\v', '\f', '\x85', '\u2028', '\u2029'):
    for newline in ('\n', '\r\n', '\r'):
        source = newline.join(['prefix = "' + separator + '"', '@decorate', 'async def target():', '    return "é"', 'outside = 7', ''])
        with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='source-oracle-', dir=Path.cwd() / '.local') as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            write(TextFile(resolve_path(root / 'sample.py'), source))
            repository = Repository.new()
            discovery = discover_repository_resource_addresses(repository=repository, root=resolve_path(root), maximum_resource_count=2, maximum_traversal_entry_count=4)
            snapshot = observe_repository_resources(repository=repository, root=resolve_path(root), addresses=discovery.addresses, maximum_resource_bytes=10000)
            corpus = realize_repository_text_corpus(definition=define_repository_text_corpus(discovery=discovery, selected_addresses=discovery.addresses), snapshot=snapshot)
            try:
                index = build_source_search_index(snapshot, corpus=corpus, window_lines=2, overlap_lines=1)
            except Exception as error:
                raise AssertionError('valid Python source cannot be indexed with preserved physical coordinates') from error
            symbols = next(view.units for view in index.views if view.kind == 'symbol')
            unit = next(unit for unit in symbols if unit.qualified_name == 'target')
            physical = list(StringIO(source, newline=''))
            expected = ''.join(physical[1:4]).rstrip('\r\n')
            assert unit.text == expected, (repr(separator), repr(newline), repr(unit.text))
            assert unit.start_line == 2 and unit.end_line == 4
            assert source[unit.start:unit.end] == unit.text
            windows = next(view.units for view in index.views if view.kind == 'window')
            starts = []
            offset = 0
            for line in physical:
                starts.append(offset)
                offset += len(line)
            assert all(unit.start in starts for unit in windows)
            assert all(len(list(StringIO(unit.text, newline=''))) <= 2 for unit in windows)
            coverage = set()
            for window in windows:
                coverage.update(range(window.start, window.end))
                assert source[window.start:window.end] == window.text
            assert coverage == set(range(len(source)))
            assert search_repository_source(index, query='target', mode='symbol').hits
print('SOURCE_SPANS_ACCEPTANCE_PASS')
